violation_type.title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §747.2327(a))
violation_type.short_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant
violation_type.typical_finding: An eleven-month-old infant was positioned on their tummy during naptime. This positioning was rectified during the inspection when the caregiver relocated the infant from the crib to an alternative location. Safe sleep procedures were discussed with the primary caregiver.

finding_variants.text: An eleven-month-old infant was positioned on their tummy during naptime. This positioning was rectified during the inspection when the caregiver relocated the infant from the crib to an alternative location. Safe sleep procedures were discussed with the primary caregiver.
A three-month-old infant was unable to roll over was observed on his tummy
An infant was observed being placed on their stomach in a play yard.
An infant was not placed in their own crib to sleep.    During the inspection the infant was moved but woken up during the transition.
An infant under 6 months old was observed sleeping face down. The caregiver placed the infant on their back during the inspection.
An infant was observed laying in a play yard swaddled and in a face down position. This was corrected at inspection.
